info.name: SmartStudy API v1
info.description:
REST API of SmartStudy - Student Study Planner and Progress Tracking System.

1. Start the backend (http://localhost:8080).
2. Run 'Auth > Login (demo student)' (or Register).
3. Run the other requests. IDs created by POST requests are stored in collection variables automatically.

Authentication is a server-side session (HttpOnly cookie SMARTSTUDY_SESSION). Keep Postman's cookie jar enabled (Settings > General > 'Automatically follow redirects' is irrelevant; cookies are stored per domain - make sure localhost is not blocked). The collection pre-request script adds the CSRF header to POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests.

exec: // SmartStudy uses session cookies + CSRF protection.
// For every state-changing request this script fetches a CSRF token (GET /auth/csrf)
// and sends it in the X-CSRF-TOKEN header. Postman's cookie jar keeps the session cookie.
// Add a header 'X-Skip-CSRF: true' to a request to demonstrate the 403 CSRF_INVALID response.
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error('Could not fetch CSRF token', err || res.code); return; }

Creates the account and signs the student in (session cookie is set). Use a new email each time.

Restores the demo password.
dayOfWeek: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday. Times are in the student's time zone. Windows on one day must not overlap.
Completing a topic schedules its first revision (SM-2).
Dates are examples - change them to dates in the future relative to today.

request.description: Readiness = 0.30 syllabus + 0.30 mastery + 0.25 mock tests + 0.15 revision. Also stores today's snapshot.
Topic scores update topic mastery: Mastery = 0.6 x latest + 0.4 x historical average.
Both fields optional (defaults: today, 7 days). Completed, locked and manual sessions are kept.
Optional ?date=YYYY-MM-DD selects the week containing that date.
Up to 62 days.
204 when no plan has been generated yet.
Returns 409 CONFLICT when it overlaps another session. Dates are examples - change them to dates in the future relative to today.
Locked sessions are never moved by plan regeneration.
Allowed from 60 minutes before the planned start; earlier attempts return 422 BUSINESS_RULE with an explanation.
>= 80 % of the planned time -> COMPLETED, otherwise INCOMPLETE and the rest is rescheduled. REVISION sessions require revisionRating. A session that has not started yet returns 422.
Marks MISSED and reschedules into the next free slot.
rating: AGAIN | HARD | GOOD | EASY. The topic must be COMPLETED first.
204 when nothing is running.
The server computes the real focus time; the client value can only lower it.
Resources of other students are reported as not found, so IDs cannot be probed.
